output.question: Find the populations of London, Paris, and Berlin and tell me which two are closest in size.

sources.title: List of European cities by population within city limits - Wikipedia
Largest Cities by Population 2026 - World Population Review

output.findings:
Based on recent population data for city proper limits, London is the largest of the three, with a population typically cited between 9 million and 9.2 million. Berlin has a population of approximately 3.7 million. Paris (city proper) has a significantly smaller population, typically cited around 2.1 million.

Comparing these figures, Berlin (approx. 3.7 million) and Paris (approx. 2.1 million) are closer in size to each other than either is to London (approx. 9.1 million), although there remains a substantial gap of roughly 1.6 million people between Berlin and Paris.
